note: Do not edit data/cases.json or the drawings. In 'room' the redacted file is compared with the original in an image viewer after the command (see 'also'). Only the Learn sample photo and drawn labels are used: no real photos of people.
prepare: # owner signs in as labadmin (device code), not on camera
$me = az ad signed-in-user show --query id -o tsv
az group create -n rg-mglab-ai-13 -l westeurope -o none
$o = az deployment group create -g rg-mglab-ai-13 -f infra/main.bicep -p infra/main.bicepparam -p developerPrincipalId=$me --query properties.outputs -o json | ConvertFrom-Json
python -m photoscan fetch-sample   # downloads the Learn sample photo, off camera
Start-Sleep -Seconds 300   # role assignment propagation (up to 5 minutes)
python -m photoscan analyze build/photos/label-clean.png | Out-Null   # dry run

steps: Show the person pixelated while the names on the room display stay readable

screens.name: resource
steps: Open the Vision resource in rg-mglab-ai-13 > Overview (pricing tier Free F0, region West Europe, endpoint masked)
Open Keys and Endpoint / Identity and show local authentication disabled
Open Access control (IAM) and show Cognitive Services User for the lab account
mask: tenant name / directory in the top bar
signed-in user name, UPN and avatar in the account menu

teardown: az cognitiveservices account purge -g rg-mglab-ai-13 -n $env:VISION_NAME -l westeurope
